title: Token refresh waits 60 s on the phone (web 5 s or 15 s), and the two disagree on what a server error means
evidence: Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 3b part A (US-10 AC17, PR 2115): the web Dropbox refresh names its outcome by the table (a 5xx 'no-answer', a 400 or 401 'refused'), raised before its call, so a save or erase that meets a 5xx refresh no longer reads as may-have-landed; the save cause is unchanged ('other', retried). Left: PR 3b part B (outcome required). Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 3 (US-10 AC16, PR 2108): the save cause reads the typed reason, so a Dropbox refresh answered 5xx (no 'reconnect') stays 'other' and is retried (pinned). Left: the web's lostAtLoad still reads the status (R6 PR 4), and the phone's OAuth bounds. Root fix R6 (triage 2026-11-25): every storage failure carries a typed reason set where it is raised. needs a look: the web half may be done by PR 1554 (6a2a0daa0, commit 034627a1a): dropbox.ts:346-356 marks only a 400 or 401 as 'reconnect', though a 5xx message still says 'please reconnect'; the refresh is bounded at TRANSFER_DEADLINE_MS.tokenRefresh 5 s (dropbox.ts:341). The phone half is open: OAuthClient.swift:43,50 URLSession.shared, no timeout on the token POST (:199-217), 400/401 = sign in again. ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/OAuthClient.swift:48,195-215 URLSession.shared 60 s, 400/401 = sign in again vs dropbox.ts:315 (5 s), drive.ts:334 (15 s, US-09 AC13h), web Dropbox treats any non-ok refresh as reconnect (dropbox.ts:320-323). No test. Fable ruled 2026-11-11: (R3) two PRs: the phone takes the web's bounds; the web stops treating a 5xx as reconnect, and that web half is sync class (adversary + Codex). iPhone survey 2026-11-11 (main fcc4ed9b) L5
